title: Convergence and Divergence of Epistolary Narrative Voice in The Tenant of Wildfell Hall and Message on Longing and Passion
core_idea: A comparative study examining how epistolary narrative voice functions in The Tenant of Wildfell Hall and Message on Longing and Passion, identifying points of convergence and divergence in voice and their implications for representing longing and passion.
tldr: Compare the epistolary voices of two texts to map similarities and differences in how they convey longing and passion.
